library.name: NiusAudio
library.author: NiusRobotLab
library.sentence: Arduino audio library for common codec, ADC, DAC, amplifier, microphone, and wireless audio modules.
library.paragraph: Provides a clean Arduino style API and modular board drivers for common audio modules across ESP32 plus compile-safe RP2040, RP2350, nRF52, STM32, SAMD, Renesas, and AVR families.

library.name: NiusZigbee
library.author: dunknowcoding (NiusRobotLab)
library.sentence: Drive external Zigbee / IEEE 802.15.4 radio modules (CC2530, ...) from an ArduinoNRF nRF52840 board.
library.paragraph: Host-side Zigbee / IEEE 802.15.4 stack for external 2.4 GHz modules over a hardware UART. Ships an SDCC CC2530 MAC/PHY helper firmware (raw 802.15.4 send/receive, hardware PAN/address filtering, Auto ACK, CCA transmit, retries, promiscuous sniffing) and a growing native Zigbee PRO stack on the nRF52840: short-address MAC + association join, active scan + parent selection, AODV route discovery and multi-hop forwarding, AES-CCM* NWK and APS security, end-to-end acked delivery, APS fragmentation, ZDO discovery and network management (Mgmt_Lqi/Rtg), source binding, network-state persistence, Trust-Center key-transport tooling (AES-MMO/HMAC specialized keys) with per-joiner install-code link keys and key rotation, broadcast transaction table, sleepy-end-device queue + keep-alive with the CC2530 v0.5 auto-ACK frame-pending bit, PAN-ID conflict + channel-change network manager, Touchlink + Green Power proxy/sink commissioning over real inter-PAN MAC frames, plus reusable ZCL device clusters and reporting helpers. Flash the module firmware with the ArduinoNRF board package's built-in CC-Debugger - no external TI programmer required. Extensible to more modules and a future Z-Stack backend.
